summary: Singleton of the scripted-light effect requests, filled by esv::script::light::EffectRequestSystem::UpdateScriptedLightEffects. Lives from level load (situation idle); empty in every sample.

fields.name: EffectEntity
fields.evidence: ls::PlayEffectOnEntityRequest (name from the IndexedStorage assert in EoCServer.dll+0x4E98F0). The adder defaults +0 to the null handle; UpdateScriptedLightEffects (EoCServer.dll+0x4EC920) stores the entity it has just created for the effect (the same handle it puts into the light's EffectComponent).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Adder constructs a FixedString at +8; UpdateScriptedLightEffects assigns the first FixedString (+0) of the light's 8-byte effect-parameters component (esv::script::light::EffectParametersComponent, read in the same WorldView) - probably the effect resource.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Adder defaults it to the null handle; UpdateScriptedLightEffects stores the scripted light entity the query is iterating (the entity holding the effect parameters).

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Adder constructs a FixedString at +0x18; UpdateScriptedLightEffects assigns the second FixedString (+4) of the effect-parameters component (perhaps a bone/attachment name).

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2EAA9B0 allocates 0x10 and zeroes pointer, capacity, size. EoCServer.dll+0x4EC920 (EffectRequestSystem::UpdateScriptedLightEffects) clears it per frame destroying FixedStrings at +8/+0x18 of 0x20-byte elements ('ls::IndexedStorage<struct ls::PlayEffectOnEntityRequest>') and appends with EoCServer.dll+0x4E98F0 (stride 0x20). Live: one instance, all zero (empty array).

open_questions: Meaning of the two FixedStrings (effect parameters +0 and +4).
